title: Derive the QQ16 decoder's entry norm and grid from exact F0/B1
body:
## Summary

```text
Physical F0 inputs with norm H and grid 2^-f
  -> exact F0 followed by B_1_2
  -> post-B1 norm <= 17628H and grid exponent f+ceil(lambda/2)+6+9lambda
  -> existing finite decoder, with its error target translated to original-input units
```

Adds `research/qq16-producer-entry-contract/` with a conditional entry lemma, per-port certificate, source pins and registered replay. For lambda=1, f=64, H<=1 and original-input error target H*2^-64, the inherited decoder admits a sufficient 532-bit component format. This is not a minimum or a producer-interior format.

Follows the entry-contract handoff in [Discussion2727](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727) and the [numerical-contract map](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/main/docs/research/qq16-numerical-contract-map.md). Scope is refined from `joint-query-controller`, priority revision 5. No new inverse, child tariff, supplier or kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before, PR2807 assumes post-B1 B, E and Q0. After, the proof supplies conservative values from physical entry to the pinned exact F0/B1 producer, including unframing and physical output frames.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 normal/optimized replay and five test groups pass. Checks include 224 scalar basis inputs, sixteen noncommuting four-owner fixtures, Gaussian products through 72 factors, source/typed-receipt corruption, Git-free replay and exclusive regeneration. Optimized CPython 3.13.5 tests also pass.
- The unchanged joint-query producer replay passes 37 native cases, 712 scalar columns per orientation and 16,384 new native columns. Original recursive child interiors remain inherited.
- Eight repository package-diagnostic tests, Ruff, warning-as-error compilation and the 13-file committed-byte preflight pass.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-producer-entry-contract
```

Scientific base: `9d76996a4cb4f558481067d10fd994f4f6c6d88a`. Submission compatibility checked against canonical main `afc158a25ef3e0bd80de81d1eb5339f0dace118e`; relevant guidance, selected result and inputs unchanged. Complete overlap snapshots cover 277 open PRs, 1,650 Discussions and 2,366 closed/merged PRs. No advance Discussion reservation was posted; this PR is the public result.

Credit Ali Romman and the joint-query team, ywz65/PR2707/2540, Arham Tahir/PR2681, Nick Petalas/PR2736/2771/2807 and the retained QQ16/native lineage. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only a new opt-in research package is added. Frozen inputs, shared code and selected frontier are unchanged. The producer is assumed exact. Finite producer errors, physical placement/movement, ownership, complete arithmetic/storage/cleanup costs and an F17 output consumer remain open. Family decision is narrow and stop at this conditional entry implication; no complete caller admission or full selected cold replay is claimed.
